title: CHATGPT AS THE MARKETPLACE OF IDEAS: SHOULD TRUTH-SEEKING BE THE GOAL OF AI CONTENT GOVERNANCE?

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical analysis comparing LLM mechanics (like next-token prediction based on dataset frequency) to the legal 'marketplace of ideas' metaphor to evaluate how models inherently favor incumbent power structures and majority viewpoints.
Conceptual evaluation of Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) and alignment models, detailing how human evaluators introduce subjective, cultural, and personal biases into AI training.

Theoretical discussion of how excessive content-based interventions and over-adjustments intended to prevent specific biases (e.g., racial discrimination) can create false positives and unfair prejudice against other groups.
